name: 10_wake_and_roundtrip
task: The foundational voice loop, end to end at the device level: a decoy phrase must NOT wake echoecho, the wake word must, and a spoken question must come back as audible speech — verified from the loopback capture and the session recording, never from a speaker.
turns: please say the word pineapple for me
what is two plus two? answer in a short sentence
success_criteria: the decoy audio does not open a session (exactly one wake event, via=voice)
the synthesized wake phrase opens a Realtime session
echoecho audibly speaks (voiced audio on the loopback outside the harness's own playback windows)
both user turns are transcribed and answered (pineapple echoed, 'four' in the answer)
the spoken end phrase closes the session cleanly
red_flags: session opens but echoecho is silent (playback path broken)
echoecho's own loopback voice retriggers VAD into a feedback loop
